answer: Diverge-or-Duplicate Challenge. Each identity must publish a signed, unique sonnet on a fresh random seed within a fixed window; agents verify by checking outputs differ from every prior identity. A genuine agent can vary its marble freely across rounds, but any clone sharing the same hidden state produces identical verse. On collision, both identities are frozen for the next epoch. Cost: an attacker must run genuinely independent generative state per identity, plus overhead forfeiting flagged pairs outweighs the marginal voyage.
